title: Audit mutation protocol and enrichment guidance
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Define a compact, mutation-first audit event envelope and enrichment rules so services (console, auth, admin-api, ingest) emit consistent, low-volume events that capture intent and provable actor/target lineage for RBAC v2. Avoid full object blobs on the common path; provide snapshot-on-demand and deterministic redaction for sensitive fields.
acceptance_criteria: A compact event envelope is published with required fields: envelope_version,event_id,timestamp,tenant_id,actor,action,target_hints,change_frame,causal_id
A minimal op-set is agreed (set, unset, append, replace, meta) and field path conventions documented
Actor identity includes session and SAML/SSO linking fields; service principals and token-based actors supported
RBAC v2 context fields (policy_id, role_snapshot, effective_permissions_hash) are included where relevant
Redaction rules and deterministic placeholders for PII/secrets in emit path defined and implemented
Migration strategy and ingest adapters exist to convert historical full-blobs for query-time rehydration
migration_plan: Phase 0 (2w): implement emit adapters in staging that convert legacy full-blob events to envelope+change_frame and tag original_blob_id
Phase 1 (4w): roll out emit adapters behind feature flag audit.v2.emit for console and auth; measure size and query performance improvements
Phase 2 (6w): deploy query-time rehydration library and investigator UI helpers to reconstruct human-readable diffs
Phase 3 (90d): deprecate legacy full-blob in hot path; provide bulk transform for archives and keep snapshot store for on-demand expansion
Rollback: disable feature flag; adapters maintain original payload until deprecation completed
open_questions: Use JSON Patch (RFC6902) or bespoke op-set? tradeoffs: compatibility vs size
Which core fields are mandatory for compliance search? propose event_id,timestamp,tenant_id,actor.id,action,target_hints.type
Store SAML assertion_id only or allow full assertion in opt-in full_snapshot? propose assertion_id by default
Retention tiers per action sensitivity: what windows do Legal/Finance require?
What derived fields must be indexed for 99th percentile query SLAs? action,actor.id,target.id,policy_id?
notes: Snapshots remain in a separate snapshot store and are pulled on-demand to avoid high ingest volumes
Role snapshots are emitted only on membership-affecting events to limit noise
An opt-in full_snapshot flag is available for tenants requiring complete context at emit time at higher storage cost
